sentences.text: The client was sideswiped by a Metro-North utility vehicle on Cedar Street in New Rochelle, injuring both shoulders, both knees and his head.
sentences.quote: Sideswiped by a Metro-North utility vehicle on Cedar Street, New Rochelle. Both shoulders, both knees, and a head injury.

sentences.text: Treatment is still active and ongoing over three years post-loss, with no discharge and no MMI declared.
sentences.quote: Active and ongoing, over three years post-loss. Never discharged, no MMI declared.

sentences.text: Liability is contested on two separate levels, and neither has been investigated yet.
sentences.quote: Contested on two independent levels, neither investigated.
